title: Syntiant, which develops low-power AI processors, files for a US IPO, reporting a $20.9M net loss on $64.5M in revenue for the three months ended March 31 (Pragyan Kalita/Reuters)
summary: Pragyan Kalita / Reuters: Syntiant, which develops low-power AI processors, files for a US IPO, reporting a $20.9M net loss on $64.5M in revenue for the three months ended March 31 — Semiconductor and software company Syntiant Corp filed for an initial public offering in the United States on Monday.
